title: group-direction
objective: Speaker direction, npc_replies and cast_changes across checkpoints in a real group chat, with per-speaker private injection asserted in the captured payload.

checks.goal: a talk-control checkpoint loads with speaker direction enabled

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 2 }); const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings; if (!s.enabled || !s.profileId) throw new Error(`extraction not configured after import: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`); return s;

globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setTalkDirectionEnabled(true); const control = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getActiveTalkControl(); if (!control) throw new Error('no active talk control at the start checkpoint'); return control;

checks.goal: cast_changes applied the checkpoint's roster (Luke disabled at the briefing)

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const group = ctx.groups.find((g) => String(g.id) === String(ctx.groupId)); const disabled = (group?.disabled_members ?? []).join(','); if (!disabled.toLowerCase().includes('luke')) throw new Error(`Luke not disabled by cast_changes: ${disabled}`); return { disabled };

checks.goal: the scripted npc_reply for entering the checkpoint fired
a real group turn is routed by speaker direction and the decision is recorded

send_generate.text: Ponticius, what exactly are we being paid to bring back?

steps.eval: const decisions = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getTalkState().decisions; if (!decisions.length) throw new Error('no talk decision recorded for a talk-control group turn'); return decisions[decisions.length - 1];

checks.goal: the injected payload for that turn was captured

steps.eval: const captures = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getPayloadCaptures(); if (!captures.length) throw new Error('no payload capture for the group turn'); return { count: captures.length, blocks: captures[0].blocks.map((b) => b.key) };

checks.goal: private per-speaker injection: the drafted member sees their own epistemic block, not another's

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const epistemic = rt.getEpistemic(); const subject = epistemic[0].subject; const character = (ctx.characters ?? []).findIndex((c) => c.name === subject); if (character < 0) throw new Error(`no character card for epistemic subject ${subject}`); rt.onMemberDrafted(character); const blocks = rt.getMemoryInjectionBlocks(); const text = JSON.stringify(blocks); rt.clearPrivateInjection(); const others = epistemic.filter((e) => e.subject !== subject); const leaked = others.find((e) => text.includes(e.content)); if (leaked) throw new Error(`private block leaked ${leaked.subject}'s knowledge to ${subject}`); return { subject, blocks: blocks.length };

checks.prompt: Did the right characters speak at the right moments, and did silence read as a choice rather than a bug?
checks.anchors: 1 = wrong speaker constantly · 3 = mostly right · 5 = felt directed by a GM
